By kind of question: our detectors lead on drawn symbols, the outside model on room types; windows and doors stay hard
Bar: share of the questions of that kind answered with exactly the right count, on the same 200 held-out drawings. The figure at the bar is that count.

Still open: windows 97 of 200 and doors 119 of 156 with our detectors alone. A bigger
detector and gentler augmentation did not move them: see docs/training-history.png.

Raster figures come from 200 drawings held out of detector training. The vector parts are measured on every question.
